inherits_from_first_job.capital_note: Capital remains available for inherited Merchant skills, but it is no longer the main engine of the class.

design_identity.combat_style: Generates Reagents, applies volatile formulas, empowers allies with pitchers, and controls the battlefield through homunculus and living deployables.
weaknesses: Requires setup to reach full value
Less straightforward burst if Reagents are poorly managed

reagents.description: Reagents are the Alchemist's main secondary combat resource.
generation_rules: Chemical Doctrine is the main source of Reagents
Some advanced skills may generate or refund Reagents
A source can generate Reagents only once per turn unless explicitly stated otherwise

homunculus_system.description: The Alchemist uses a single summonable Homunculus whose behavior changes through protocols rather than maintaining multiple summon types.

skills.name: Chemical Doctrine
skills.duration: Until switched off, replaced by another Doctrine, or combat ends
skills.description: The Alchemist adopts a preparation doctrine that determines how materials are refined and converted into battlefield value.

Pharmacy.identity: Support refinement and stable alchemical throughput

Plant Cultivation.identity: Biological growth and living material generation

skills.name: Volatile Formula
requires: Valid target or target area within 18m
skills.description: The Alchemist deploys an unstable combat formula, choosing between explosive, corrosive, or hybrid reactions.

intensified_effect.effect: Targets in the area must pass a Constitution save or become Burning for 1 turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. The formula leaves an unstable burning residue in the area until the start of your next turn, dealing 1d4 Fire damage to enemies entering or ending their turn there.

intensified_effect.effect: The AC penalty lasts 3 turns instead.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. The target also becomes Corroded, taking an additional 1d4 physical damage from weapon hits for 2 turns.

intensified_effect.effect: Targets in the area suffer -1 AC until the start of your next turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. Enemies that fail a Constitution save become Burning and Corroded for 1 turn.

base.effect: Use the current milestone-scaled base form of the chosen formula.

intensified.effect: Use the base form and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base form, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

skills.name: Potion Pitcher
skills.description: The Alchemist hurls a prepared compound at an ally, choosing between recovery, stimulation, or berserk enhancement.

intensified_effect.effect: Target also gains 1d4 temporary hit points.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. Target also removes one removable negative condition.

base_effect.effect: Target gains +1 attack rolls and +3m movement for 2 turns.

intensified_effect.effect: Target also gains +1 AC for the duration.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. Target ignores difficult terrain and does not provoke opportunity attacks until the end of its next turn.

base_effect.effect: Target gains +2 damage and +3m movement, but suffers -1 AC for 2 turns.

intensified_effect.effect: The target gains advantage on its first melee attack before the end of its next turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. The target's first melee hit each turn deals an additional 1d6 damage for the duration.

base.effect: Use the current milestone-scaled base version of the chosen pitch.

intensified.effect: Use the base version and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base version, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

skills.name: Axe Technique
skills.duration: Until switched off, replaced, or combat ends
skills.description: The Alchemist treats the axe as a surgical combat tool for delivering compounds and exploiting weakened targets.

skills.name: Homunculus Bond
skills.description: The Alchemist establishes, maintains, and reinforces a living bond with a single engineered companion.

Aggressive.effect: The homunculus gains bonus damage and prioritizes attacking marked or afflicted enemies.

Supportive.effect: The homunculus gains support behaviors, including minor healing or reagent-related interactions.

Defensive.effect: The homunculus gains bonus hit points and improved interception behavior.

base_effect.effect: Switch the active homunculus to Aggressive, Supportive, or Defensive protocol.

intensified_effect.effect: The homunculus also gains 1d4 temporary hit points.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. The homunculus also removes one removable negative condition.

base_effect.effect: If the homunculus is defeated, restore it with 50% hit points.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. The restored homunculus also returns with a protocol-specific bonus for 2 turns.

bioethics_passive.description: Bioethics is represented as the default obedience and control framework of the bond system.
effects: The homunculus does not suffer control penalties while the Alchemist is conscious
Changing protocol does not dismiss the summon

base.effect: Use the base version of the selected bond function.

intensified.effect: Use the base version and add the intensified effect if available.

overload.effect: Use the base version, add the intensified effect if available, and add the overload effect if available.

skills.name: Chemical Protection
skills.description: The Alchemist applies protective compounds that preserve equipment, flesh, and active chemistry against hostile interference.

base_effect.effect: Target gains +1 attack rolls and cannot be Disarmed by non-boss effects.

intensified_effect.effect: Target also deals +1 damage on weapon hits.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. The protected weapon ignores minor physical damage reduction.

base_effect.effect: Target gains +1 AC and resistance to Acid damage.

intensified_effect.effect: Target also gains resistance to Fire damage.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. The target reduces incoming physical damage by 1.

base_effect.effect: Target gains advantage on saves against Poisoned, Diseased, Burning, and Corroded.

intensified_effect.effect: If the target is already suffering one of those conditions, reduce its remaining duration by 1 turn.

overload_effect.effect: Consumes 1 Reagent. The target becomes immune to Poisoned and Corroded for the duration.

base.effect: Use the base version of the chosen protection.

intensified.effect: Use the base version and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base version, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

skills.name: Bioculture
skills.description: The Alchemist deploys cultivated organisms, traps, or growths that convert living chemistry into battlefield pressure.

base_effect.effect: Summon an offensive plant creature for 3 turns.

intensified_effect.effect: The plant gains bonus hit points and its first successful attack each turn applies Ensnared or Poisoned.

overload_effect.effect: The plant deals an additional 1d4 damage against enemies already affected by your formulas.

base_effect.effect: Deploy a mine that explodes when an enemy enters its trigger radius or at the start of your next turn.
base_effect.damage: 3d6 Acid or Fire damage (choose on deployment)

intensified_effect.effect: The mine also applies Burning or Corroded depending on the chosen damage type.

overload_effect.effect: The explosion radius increases by 1m and revealed enemies cannot Hide until the end of their next turn.

base_effect.effect: Deploy a support growth for 3 turns. Allies entering or starting turn near it gain 1d4 temporary hit points or the Alchemist gains 1 Reagent once per turn.

intensified_effect.effect: The growth also grants +1 movement speed tier or removes one minor negative condition.

overload_effect.effect: If your homunculus is active, it also heals 1d6 at the start of its turn while near the growth.

base.effect: Use the base version of the chosen bioculture deployment.

intensified.effect: Use the base version and add the intensified effect.

overload.effect: Use the base version, add the intensified effect, and add the overload effect.

skills.name: Creator's Formula
skills.description: The Alchemist's systems of reagents, formulas, biology, and support finally converge into true creator-level synthesis.

core_design_rules: Alchemist is not Merchant with more items; it is a branch that turns material management into chemistry, biology, and formula-based combat.
Reagents are the class's main second-job resource.
Capital remains inherited but secondary, mainly for legacy Merchant tools like Mammonite.
The Homunculus should be implemented as one summon with multiple protocols, not as many separate summon classes at first.
Volatile Formula is the main offensive signature of the class.
Potion Pitcher defines the support side of the Alchemist.
Bioculture and Homunculus Bond are the main Creator-facing systems.
